questions.q: What does the Japanese word "ikigai" literally combine?
According to Mogi, ikigai applies to which of the following?
a: Both tiny daily actions and big goals
questions.why: She says ikigai can be small or large.

questions.q: Which example in the book fulfills all five ikigai pillars?
questions.why: The tea ceremony meets all five pillars.

questions.q: What is the first pillar of ikigai?
questions.why: The first pillar emphasizes tiny daily positive actions.

questions.q: How does the book define the second pillar, "Release yourself"?
a: Put ego aside and enjoy without expectation
questions.why: It encourages humility and enjoying activities without reward.
